name: Clustdoc
description_en: Clustdoc runs repeatable client onboarding and application-collection processes. A process defines reusable requirements; an application is the live instance for a particular contact or case. Forms, requested documents, internal review and signing can sit in that flow. It is therefore more specific than a shared document folder: selection depends on which requirements apply, who reviews them and what evidence makes the case complete.
description_zh: Clustdoc 用于重复执行客户入驻及申请资料收集流程。Process 定义可复用要求，Application 是面向具体联系人或案例的运行实例；表单、所需文件、内部审查及签署可放在该流程中。因此它比共享文档文件夹更具体，选型取决于哪些要求适用、由谁审查，以及什么证据代表案例完成。

core_features.explanation_en: With process permission enabled, choose a custom list for one application without editing the reusable process.
core_features.explanation_zh: 启用流程权限后，可为一个申请选择专属清单而不修改可复用流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Display rules affect applicant steps; the administrator still sees the full checklist.
core_features.explanation_zh: 显示规则作用于申请人步骤，管理员仍看到完整清单。

core_features.explanation_en: Document values use Text, Date or Number and show confidence/missing-field information.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档值采用文本、日期或数字类型，并显示置信度及缺失信息。

en: Evaluate synthetic supplier onboarding with an applicable checklist, reviewed certificate and ordered signing.
zh: 用适用清单、审查后的证书及有序签署评估虚构供应商入驻。
use_cases.basis: Proposed synthetic evaluation; not an observed customer result.

Platform.en: Commercial SaaS for document-heavy onboarding; custom hosting is an offer requiring scope confirmation.
Platform.zh: 面向资料密集入驻的商业 SaaS；定制托管需确认范围。

steps.en: Define a synthetic process and the evidence required for case approval before selecting its application items.
steps.zh: 选择申请项目前，先定义虚构流程及案例批准所需证据。

integrations.scope: Signed-document delivery and integration options read; exact authentication, API quotas, schema, mapping and retries not established.

items.en: Conditional display is applicant-view behavior, not a general permission rule; extraction confidence is not authenticity.
items.zh: 条件显示属于申请人视图行为，并非通用权限规则；提取置信度不代表真实性。

supported_languages.scope: Marketing says flows in 10+ languages; complete current locale inventory and admin UI availability not verified.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: PRO display and currencies reviewed; proposal, overages and exact subscription order not verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 已核对 PRO 显示与币种，未核实提案、超额费用及精确订阅订单。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

identity_notes.scope: Original assigned website resolves to current Clustdoc site. Original slug retained; no specific historic contract migration inferred.

sections.title_en: Build one process, then decide each application’s scope
sections.title_zh: 建立一个流程，再确定每份申请的范围
sections.en:
Clustdoc’s process is a reusable set of requirements; an application is the instance run for one contact or case. The platform combines forms, file requests, communication and review around that case. The current website identifies the product as Clustdoc; this record keeps its original Clust slug for continuity.

For an editorial pilot, use a synthetic supplier registration with a contact form, insurance certificate and service agreement. Identify the case owner, required evidence and completion decision before launching anything. One supplier can have a complete upload list while a reviewer still needs to resolve an expired certificate. Keep applicant completion, staff approval and signature completion as separate observations. No process, application or real supplier record was created in this research.
sections.zh:
Clustdoc 的 Process 是可复用要求集合，Application 是为一个联系人或案例运行的实例。平台围绕案例结合表单、文件请求、交流与审查。当前官网将产品称为 Clustdoc，本档案保留原 Clust slug 以维持记录连续性。

编辑建议的试点可用虚构供应商注册，包括联系表、保险证明及服务协议。启动前明确案例负责人、所需证据和完成决定。供应商可能已上传全部材料，但审阅者仍需处理过期证明。应分别观察申请人完成、员工批准及签署完成。本研究未创建流程、申请或真实供应商记录。

sections.title_en: A custom application list leaves the process intact
sections.title_zh: 定制申请清单保留原流程
sections.en:
The custom-list option first requires enabling agent step selection in the process settings. New applications default to all items. Selecting Custom list allows choosing only relevant steps, adding other requested files and adding information fields that become an extra form, without changing the original process.

For the proposed supplier example, decide whether a certificate is irrelevant to this case or whether its display should depend on an answer. A one-off omission is different from a reusable conditional rule. Record why an item was excluded and check the created application rather than assuming the process template changed. If the option is unavailable, inspect the process configuration and the operator’s permissions before rebuilding the entire workflow. Changes to already running applications and propagation from later template edits were not fully established.
sections.zh:
定制清单首先要求在流程设置启用代理选择特定步骤。新申请默认包含全部项目。选择 Custom list 后，可选相关步骤、增加其他所需文件，以及增加会形成新表单的信息字段，而不修改原流程。

在建议的供应商示例中，应判断某证明是本案例不适用，还是应随某个答案决定显示。一次性省略不同于可复用条件规则。应记录排除原因，检查创建后的申请，而不是假设流程模板已改变。选项不可用时，先检查流程配置及操作人员权限，再决定是否重建工作流。对既有运行申请的修改及后续模板编辑传播未完整核实。

sections.title_en: Hidden to an applicant does not mean hidden to an administrator
sections.title_zh: 对申请人隐藏不等于对管理员隐藏
sections.en:
Conditional display applies only to end-user checklist views. Administrators see all steps for review, and a display rule on an internal-only step has no effect on applicant visibility. The FAQ advises checking conditions when referenced elements have been changed or removed.

A spreadsheet step separately controls whether it is required, visible to the end user and approved immediately or left pending review. Once approved, that spreadsheet cannot be edited by the end user. For the supplier pilot, test both applicable and inapplicable branches using synthetic answers, then compare the staff and applicant views. Keep an internally completed worksheet distinct from a required applicant response. Inspect the exact values before approval, and establish the supported way to correct an approved error; do not assume the applicant can simply reopen it. No visibility or approval operation was executed.
sections.zh:
条件显示仅作用于终端用户清单视图。管理员为审查看到全部步骤，给仅内部可见步骤添加显示规则不会影响申请人视图。FAQ 建议在引用元素被修改或删除时检查条件。

表格步骤另行控制是否必填、是否向终端用户显示，以及完成后直接批准还是待审。一旦批准，终端用户不能再编辑该表格。供应商试点应以虚构答案测试适用与不适用分支，再比较员工和申请人视图。应区分内部完成的工作表与申请人必填响应，批准前检查精确值，并明确已批准错误的受支持修正方法，不能假定申请人可直接重开。本研究未执行可见性或审批操作。

sections.title_en: Role restrictions do not remove a business user seat
sections.title_zh: 角色受限不代表不占业务用户席位
sections.en:
The July 2026 role guide defines a user by their own account login, including read-only or infrequent access. Adding users beyond the base allowance triggers charges. The team owner includes billing control; an Admin excludes billing, while an Agent cannot act on teammates’ applications and a Super-Agent can. External members act for another stakeholder rather than owning the application.

For the pilot, map the operator, reviewer and outside representative to their intended access before counting seats. Check granular export, uploaded-file deletion, reset and approval permissions rather than relying on a role name. The Developer description contains contradictory Process-access wording, so its exact capability needs confirmation. Do not treat a read-only account as automatically free or an outside representative as interchangeable with the applicant. No user was invited or billed.
sections.zh:
2026 年 7 月角色指南按独立账户登录定义用户，包括只读或偶尔访问。超过基础额度新增用户会产生收费。团队所有者含账单控制，Admin 不含账单；Agent 不能处理同事申请，Super-Agent 可以。External member 代表其他相关方操作，并非申请所有者。

试点应先把操作人员、审阅者和外部代表映射至目标访问，再计算席位。应检查导出、上传文件删除、重置及审批等细粒度权限，不能只靠角色名称。Developer 描述对 Process 访问存在矛盾，精确能力需确认。不能把只读账户自动视为免费，也不能把外部代表与申请人等同。本研究未邀请用户或产生账单。

sections.title_en: Extraction confidence and auto-approval need separate checks
sections.title_zh: 提取置信度与自动批准需分别检查
sections.en:
AI features are available on request, disabled by default and require the customer’s own AI provider account and credentials. The vendor states that it does not train models on customer data; that statement does not independently establish every connected provider’s terms. Prevalidation can trigger actions such as automatic approval or a failure notification if configured.

Extraction separately defines fields with Text, Date or Number types. The step panel shows missing fields and confidence; replacing a document updates the values. Extracted fields can feed merge fields elsewhere. For the synthetic certificate, compare supplier name and expiry with the source image and test a replacement containing a different date. Confirm downstream use before enabling automatic decisions. A high confidence value is not proof of authenticity, and generated conditions still need branch tests. No credentials, document or AI request was sent.
sections.zh:
AI 功能需申请，默认禁用，并要求连接客户自己的 AI 提供方账户及凭据。厂商声明不以客户数据训练模型，但这不独立确立所有连接提供方的条款。预验证在配置后可触发自动批准或失败通知等动作。

提取功能另外定义文本、日期或数字类型字段，步骤面板显示缺失字段及置信度；替换文档会更新数值，提取字段还能用于其他位置的合并字段。虚构证书测试应把供应商名称、到期日与原图比较，并替换成另一日期的文件。启用自动决定前确认下游用途。高置信度不证明真实性，生成的条件仍需分支测试。本研究未发送凭据、文档或 AI 请求。

sections.title_en: Review routing and signing order require different evidence
sections.title_zh: 审查路由与签署顺序需要不同证据
sections.en:
The approval page describes predefined routing, required checkpoints, action history and configurable escalation to a backup approver. The built-in signing workflow supports sequential or parallel signing and prefilling documents from form data. Signing and internal approval therefore need distinct acceptance criteria.

For the proposed service agreement, verify the reviewed document values before the signature stage, then check who signs next and what happens when a reviewer misses a deadline. If parallel signing is intended, ensure it is explicitly configured rather than inferred from multiple recipients. Inspect the returned signed artifact and completion evidence before passing it to another system. Vendor claims of legal validity are not a determination for every jurisdiction, contract or identity check. Rejection routing, document replacement after signature, webhook retries and restoration of signed records were not tested.
sections.zh:
审批页描述预定义路由、必需检查点、操作历史及向备用审批者升级的配置。内置签署流程支持顺序或并行签署，并可从表单数据预填文档。因此签署与内部批准需分别设定验收条件。

建议服务协议测试应在签署阶段前检查已审文档数值，再确认下一位签署者及审查逾期的处理。若需要并行签署，应明确配置，不能从有多个接收者推断。传至其他系统前，应检查返回的已签产物及完成证据。厂商法律效力主张不等于对每个法域、合同或身份核查的判断。拒绝路由、签后文档替换、webhook 重试及已签记录恢复未测试。

sections.title_en: Count new applications, business users and storage
sections.title_zh: 计算新申请、业务用户与存储
sections.en:
The live currency tabs show PRO at €190/month or $190/month, including 3 seats, 50 new applications monthly and 25 GB. These are displayed offers, not a currency conversion. EXPERT is quoted with at least 5 seats, 150 new applications monthly and 50 GB; ULTIMATE is custom with at least 10 seats. PRO marks signatures and reminders as limited usage.

The pricing FAQ defines an application as a workflow instance, not an uploaded document. A pilot with many files inside one case is therefore different from many new cases. Confirm how reopened, duplicated, test and abandoned cases count, how overages work and what is archived before estimating cost. The public route is a discovery call and proposal; no fixed current self-service trial or ongoing free tier was established. No currency-specific order, tax or invoice was verified.
sections.zh:
实际币种标签显示 PRO 为每月 190 欧元或 190 美元，含 3 个席位、每月 50 份新申请及 25 GB。这些是显示的报价入口，不是汇率换算。EXPERT 需询价，至少 5 席、每月 150 份新申请及 50 GB；ULTIMATE 定制且至少 10 席。PRO 把签署及提醒标为有限用量。

定价 FAQ 将申请定义为工作流实例，而不是上传文件。一个案例包含很多文件，与创建很多新案例不同。估算费用前需确认重开、复制、测试及放弃案例如何计数、超额如何处理，以及哪些内容归档。公开路径为需求沟通及提案，未确立固定的当前自助试用或持续免费层。本研究未核实币种专属订单、税或账单。

sections.title_en: Resolve renewal notice and the return artifact before entry
sections.title_zh: 开始前明确续期通知与数据返还产物
sections.en:
The terms grant a limited commercial SaaS license; software ownership and a software copy are not transferred. Fees are generally non-refundable unless the contract says otherwise. Subscription periods renew by default, with three months’ written non-renewal notice unless the order differs. This needs reconciling with the pricing FAQ’s broader cancellation language, especially for a monthly order.

The terms promise data return in a standard usable format within ten working days after contract end. That is not a tested reconstruction of forms, permissions, signatures and automation. The privacy notice separately allows legal and claims retention after the relationship ends; closing an account does not prove immediate erasure of every record. Define the exit contents, notice deadline and retrieval method before subscribing. Recovery of deleted applications, archive fidelity and operational rollback remain unverified. No agreement was accepted or cancellation sent.
sections.zh:
条款授予有限商业 SaaS 许可，不转移软件所有权或软件副本。除非合同另有规定，一般费用不退款。订阅默认续期，除非订单不同，需提前三个月书面通知不续期。这需与定价 FAQ 更宽泛的取消措辞协调，尤其是月度订单。

条款承诺合同结束后十个工作日内以标准可用格式返还数据，但本研究未验证它可重建表单、权限、签署和自动化。隐私通知另允许关系结束后基于法律及争议保留；关闭账户不证明每类记录立即擦除。订阅前需定义退出内容、通知期限及提取方法。已删申请恢复、归档保真及运行回退仍未核实。本研究未接受协议或发送取消请求。

seo.title_zh: Clustdoc：申请清单、审查角色与用量条件

Does a read-only business account count as a user?

research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、流程、申请、邀请、用户、AI 凭据、文档、签署、付款、删除、导出或恢复操作。
